question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/784ca6f48d526f629c9965d16fb3b1d9d8f94f4e51868f4b071aafdc116713c2.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series:

The symbol V's movement is shown below where 'V' rotates 90º in the clockwise direction in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f062a3e36ed3fafaa1b5b83f6599a085ea690f467deb81f457eef17986793ae1.png] 

The symbol C's movement is shown below where the symbol 'C' rotates 90º in the anticlockwise direction in each step.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a263e818004093ecb2404d20e592dfa9dbe730f948bcf6bec6f59ee233d34fb.png] 

The answer figure is [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96f8c553726eca03c47dc0c1f9913035a9d14a548ec3a3aed3a89f5d53f86d47.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
